facts.fact: Farrow Harley-Davidson's video says the dealership has been in business since 1912 and calls it Ohio's original home for Harley-Davidson riding.
facts.quote: Since 1912, Farrow Harley-Davidson has been Ohio's original home for freedom on two wheels.

facts.fact: The Farrow Harley-Davidson case study was published on January 28, 2026, and later updated on September 17, 2026.
The Farrow case study does not provide a measured sales increase or isolate the effect of its TV campaign from the dealership's other marketing.
facts.quote: It does not provide a measured sales increase or isolate the effect of TV from the dealership's other marketing.

facts.fact: The Farrow Harley-Davidson TV campaign's goal was showroom awareness among local riders, and the case study lists the business type as motorcycle dealerships.
The Farrow Harley-Davidson TV ad directed viewers to the dealership's website, and the final card lists Columbus and Sunbury, Ohio.
facts.quote: The final card shows Farrow Harley-Davidson, farrow.com, and Columbus and Sunbury, Ohio.
